newsitem.title: USA: Rofin-Sinar Technologies Q1 Dec 31 net up.
newsitem.headline: Rofin-Sinar Technologies Q1 Dec 31 net up.

text.p: Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc said Tuesday increased acceptance by the auto industry to use lasers to cut and weld metal helped earnings and sales rise sharply in the first quarter ended December 31.

The company reported net income of $2.7 million, or $0.23 a share, compared to $1.4 million, or $0.17 a share, one year ago. Rofin-Sinar said pro forma earnings per share figures are based on the weighted average number of shares outstanding, which were 11.6 million in 1996 and 8.6 million in 1995.
Sales climbed to $34.0 million from $23.7 million.
Its shares were trading up 1/2 Tuesday at 12-3/8.
